mainEntity.name: What are the common signs that I need new windows?

acceptedAnswer.text: Several indicators suggest it might be time for window replacement. You may notice drafts, difficulty operating your windows, or condensation between glass panes. Increased energy bills, especially for heating or cooling, can also point to inefficient windows. Visible damage like rot, cracks, or warping in the frames are clear signs. If your home's interior temperature is inconsistent, or if outside noise is more prominent than usual, upgrading your windows can improve comfort and reduce sound transmission.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common signs for new windows include drafts, condensation, high energy bills, and difficulty operating them. Visible damage like rot or warping also indicates a need for replacement.
